notes.title: BUTT is releasing on July 15th!!
notes.notes:
BUTT is releasing on July 15th at 8AM PST, 11AM EST, 4PM GMT+1

Download the game for free then and collect around 50 unique butts. We'll also have a special limited time butt available for free at launch to all our early players (an announcement on this coming soon).

For more information, suggestions, and to join our growing community, check out our Discord.
https://discord.gg/Wbq8mrkAZ7
